name: Virtual Human Platform
what: The VHP4Safety portal: a single entry point to the chemical safety assessment services the consortium runs.

name: AOP-Wiki RDF
what: Converts the AOP-Wiki to RDF, versions every release as its own named graph, and serves it over a public SPARQL endpoint with a query interface and dashboard.

name: molAOP Builder and Analyser
what: Maps Adverse Outcome Pathway key events onto molecular pathways, and analyses the resulting molecular AOPs.

name: ToxTempAssistant
what: ToxTempAssistant helps scientists document cell-based toxicological test methods more efficiently.

name: ROBOT
what: Research Object Builder for Open Toxicology.

name: pyBiodatafuse
what: Queries many biomedical databases at once and merges what comes back into a single knowledge graph, so a gene or compound list can be annotated from all of them in one step.

name: BridgeDb
what: Maps identifiers between biological databases, so that one gene or metabolite can be recognised across resources that each name it differently.

name: WikiPathways
what: An open, community-curated pathway database. The department maintains its semantic layer and the clients most people actually use.

name: PathVisio
what: Desktop software to draw, edit and visualise biological pathways, and export them to WikiPathways.

name: ArrayAnalysis
what: Preprocesses and statistically analyses RNA-sequencing and microarray transcriptomics data.

name: AOP-Builder
what: Extracts key scientific entities and their relationships from the literature to help build Adverse Outcome Pathways.

name: AOP-Suite
what: A web-based tool for building, visualising and analysing Adverse Outcome Pathway networks.

name: O-QT
what: An AI assistant that drives the OECD QSAR Toolbox to assess chemical hazards and summarise the results.

name: MCT8 Docking
what: Predicts how strongly a compound binds the MCT8 thyroid-hormone transporter, using neural-network-enhanced molecular docking.

name: qAOP-App
what: Predicts key events and adverse outcomes over time from ODE-based quantitative Adverse Outcome Pathway models.

name: QSPRpred
what: Predicts chemical activity across endpoints using target-specific and pretrained QSAR models.

name: xploreAOP
what: Visualises Adverse Outcome Pathway networks and lets a user explore them interactively.

name: Llemy
what: Answers questions about lipid metabolism and its toxicology using pathway knowledge, live literature search and AI-generated summaries.

name: R-ODAF
what: An R Shiny interface for standardised RNA-seq differential-expression analysis in regulatory toxicology.
